limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: Finite command model; no physical optical accuracy or power-sequence validation.
Completed data remains readable; no forced new generation per HIL request.
No ID/ready register exists; none invented.
Overlapping conversions/MTreg updates and reads beyond two result bytes are model_unsupported.
Early read behavior modeled as retained value; phase-level bus behavior not exhaustively proved.
Fault diagnostics do not prove complete recovery, repeated startup is not a functional requirement.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile candidates.
